change: Evidence admission requirement: For EVERY A_BETTER or B_BETTER dimension, include at least one short literal excerpt from A AND at least one from B. A reason mentioning B does not replace a B excerpt. If a relevant instruction is absent on one side, state precisely what is absent in absentEvidenceExplanation (at least 20 characters); never invent a quotation. Do not claim an instruction is absent without checking the full supplied text. An empty evidence array always needs that concrete explanation.
